data.description: Green Community East – Enjoy a Lifestyle Rooted in Nature and Community

data.answer:
Green Community East Dubai is a peaceful, gated residential development offering a blend of nature and modern living. Known for its lush green landscapes and well-planned infrastructure, it provides a serene environment for families and professionals seeking a retreat from the city's fast-paced lifestyle. With tree-lined pathways, open green spaces, and a strong sense of community, it stands out as one of Dubai’s most desirable places to live.

The community is designed to promote a balanced lifestyle, featuring parks, playgrounds, and a variety of amenities that cater to daily needs. Residents of Green Community East DIP benefit from a secure and well-maintained environment with 24-hour security, ensuring peace of mind. Whether enjoying a walk in the beautifully landscaped surroundings or making use of the leisure and recreational facilities, life here is designed for comfort and convenience.

The sub-community offers a variety of well-designed residential options, including villas, townhouses, and apartments, catering to different lifestyle needs. Whether you're looking for a spacious family home or a modern apartment, the community provides a range of housing choices in a serene, well-maintained environment.

Villas in Green Community East Dubai are known for their distinct Spanish-inspired architecture, featuring signature red-tiled roofs and elegant facades. These residences offer expansive balconies, large windows that allow for natural light, open-plan kitchens, en-suite bedrooms, and private parking spaces. Conveniently positioned near sports courts and retail outlets, these homes provide both luxury and convenience for residents.

Townhouses in Green Community East DIP are available in three- and four-bedroom layouts, offering spacious living areas ideal for families. Designed with comfort in mind, they include master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, a study, a maid’s room, a family area, a closed kitchen, a laundry space, and both a rooftop and outdoor terrace, complemented by a landscaped garden.

Apartments in Green Community Dubai Investment Park range from one to four-bedroom units, spanning sizes from 967 sq. ft. to 5,448 sq. ft. Each apartment is crafted with high-end finishes and features built-in wardrobes, stylish kitchen fittings, en-suite bathrooms, and private balconies. With modern interiors and quality fixtures, these residences offer a perfect blend of comfort and contemporary living.

Popular Buildings in Green Community East

Green Community East boasts several notable residential developments that cater to diverse preferences. Among these, Olivia Residences stands out, offering a range of apartments with modern amenities and contemporary designs.

Additionally, Lakeview Apartments offer scenic views and a serene living environment, while Southwest Apartments 4 provides a selection of well-appointed residences. 

Off-Plan Projects in Green Community East

The community continues to evolve with new developments. A notable off-plan project is the Courtyard by Marriott, an upcoming residential development featuring one- and two-bedroom apartments. Designed with contemporary aesthetics and surrounded by green settings, this project aims to offer residents a modern lifestyle complemented by a range of planned amenities. The completion of this venture is anticipated in December 2025, promising a fresh addition to the community's residential offerings.

Renting a Property in Green Community East

Green Community East offers a selection of spacious rental villas and townhouses, ideal for those seeking a peaceful residential environment with well-maintained surroundings. Villa rentals in the community are available in five- and six-bedroom configurations, catering to families looking for larger living spaces. The annual rent for a five-bedroom villa is approximately AED 875,000, while six-bedroom villas are priced around AED 500,000 per year.

Townhouses are also available for rent, primarily in four-bedroom layouts. These homes offer generous living areas, private outdoor spaces, and a family-friendly atmosphere. The rental price for a four-bedroom townhouse typically stands at AED 250,000 per year. With its serene surroundings, ample green spaces, and access to essential amenities, renting in this community provides a balanced lifestyle away from the city's hustle while remaining well-connected to key locations.

Buying a Property in Green Community East

The area offers a variety of residential options for buyers, ranging from stylish apartments to spacious townhouses and luxurious villas. Apartments come in one- to four-bedroom layouts, featuring modern interiors and high-quality finishes. Prices for a one-bedroom unit start at AED 600,000, while two-bedroom apartments typically range from AED 1.3 million to AED 1.6 million. Larger three-bedroom apartments are priced between AED 2.19 million and AED 2.48 million, with four-bedroom units available for around AED 2.2 million.

For those looking for more expansive living spaces, villas are available in three- to six-bedroom configurations, with prices varying based on size, location, and amenities. A three-bedroom villa ranges from AED 3.3 million to AED 3.95 million, while four-bedroom villas start at AED 4.2 million. The price of five-bedroom villas can fluctuate between AED 4.7 million and AED 12.5 million, whereas six-bedroom properties are available for approximately AED 9 million.

Townhouses also present a great investment opportunity, with three- and four-bedroom units spanning over 4,000 sq. ft. A three-bedroom townhouse is priced between AED 2.3 million and AED 3.7 million, while a four-bedroom townhouse falls within the range of AED 1.89 million to AED 3.3 million. With its tranquil setting, well-planned infrastructure, and strong demand for high-quality residences, the community remains a desirable choice for homebuyers and investors alike.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Green Community East?

data.answer:
Life in Green Community Dubai Investment Park offers a perfect balance between tranquility and modern convenience. With lush green landscapes, pedestrian-friendly pathways, and a secure, family-oriented environment, residents enjoy a peaceful retreat while staying well-connected to key areas of the city.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Green Community East

As a gated neighborhood, Green Community East DIP offers dedicated parking spaces for villas and townhouses, ensuring convenience for residents. Visitors can also find ample parking along the side streets, making it easy for guests to access the community without hassle.

The Green Community East location is well-connected to Dubai’s public transport network. The Dubai Investment Park Metro Station, part of the Red Line, is situated within the community, providing seamless connectivity to key areas across the city. Additionally, several bus stops are conveniently located nearby, including those at the Main Gate Entrance, Choithram Supermarket, East Gate, and West Gate, ensuring multiple transit options for daily commuters.

Supermarkets in and Around Green Community East

Residents of Green Community Dubai have access to a variety of supermarkets for their grocery and household shopping needs. Within the sub-communities of Green Community Village and Dubai Investment Park, several well-stocked stores cater to daily essentials. Popular options include Choithrams, Park n Shop, VIVA Supermarket DIP, We Mart, and Afsha Mini Mart, all conveniently located to serve the community with fresh produce, pantry staples, and household goods.

Shopping Mall Near Green Community East

Residents have convenient access to The Market, the primary shopping destination in Dubai Investments Park, located just 7 minutes away. This retail hub offers a range of stores, supermarkets, and dining options, making it the most accessible choice for daily essentials.

Other shopping centers near Green Community East DIP include Souq Extra and Multiforms L.L.C, both within a 10 to 12-minute drive. For additional retail options, Affordables – DIP, Ramla Mall, and Ramla Hypermarket are also nearby, approximately 13 minutes away.

Schools and Nurseries Near Green Community East

Families in Green Community East Dubai have access to several well-reputed nurseries and schools within a short drive. Nearby nurseries, including British Orchard Nursery, Chubby Cheeks Nursery, Kinderville, and Little Scholar Nursery, are located just 8 to 9 minutes away. These institutions follow internationally recognized curriculums, such as the British Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS), ensuring quality early education.

For school-aged children, Dove Green Private School, Bright Riders School Dubai, and Nibras International School are within 8 to 9 minutes from the community. Greenfield International School, an IB World School, is around 13 minutes away, while The International School of Choueifat provides a rigorous academic program for students from Kindergarten to Grade 12.

Higher education options near Green Community East DIP include the University of Balamand Dubai, located just 8 minutes away. Other prominent universities, such as Keystrokes University, Synergy University Dubai, American University in Dubai, MODUL University Dubai, and University of Wollongong in Dubai (UoWD), are accessible within a 20-minute drive, offering a range of academic programs for students.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Green Community East

Al Taqwa Masjid is the closest mosque to the community, located just 9 minutes away. Other mosques, including Jamia Mosque, Zulikha Al Homidi Mosque, and ADNOC Mosque, are within an 8 to 15-minute drive and offer ample space for worshippers. These mosques provide convenient options for daily prayers and Friday congregations for residents of Green Community Dubai Investment Park.

For the Christian community, several churches can be found in Jebel Ali Village, approximately 15 minutes away. Some of the well-known churches in the area include St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church, International Nepalese Community Church, United Christian Church of Dubai, Our Lady of Annunciation Greek Orthodox Church, Dubai Mar Thoma Church, and Mor Ignatius Jacobite Syrian Orthodox Cathedral. These churches serve diverse congregations and offer various religious services throughout the week.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Green Community East

Residents of Green Community Dubai Investment Park have access to a variety of medical facilities within a short drive. GMCClinics – Green Community is just 7 minutes away, offering general healthcare services, while iCARE Clinics – Multi-Specialty Clinic is located within a 19-minute drive. Other medical centers nearby include CareOne Polyclinic, Welcare Clinic, Dr. Ismail Polyclinic, Aster Clinic, and City Centre Clinic Ibn Battuta, ensuring residents have convenient options for medical care. Pet owners can also find veterinary services at Blue Oasis Veterinary Clinic and Star Vet Clinic, both within close reach.

For specialized treatments and emergency care, hospitals such as NMC Royal Hospital in DIP, Aster Cedars Hospital, and Mediclinic Meadows are easily accessible, providing comprehensive medical services to the community.

Location & Nearby Areas

The Green Community East location in Dubai Investments Park places it near several well-known residential and commercial districts. Green Community West is just an 8-minute drive south, offering a similar tranquil and family-friendly environment. Jebel Ali Industrial, a key commercial hub, is approximately 18 minutes away, while Al Furjan, a gated residential community, is accessible within 29 minutes.

Jebel Ali Village, another well-established neighborhood, is a 27-minute drive from the area. Additionally, South Bay, a growing waterfront development, is just 15 minutes away, providing more lifestyle and leisure options for residents.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Green Community East

data.answer:
Green Community East offers a peaceful yet engaging lifestyle with plenty of recreational options. From scenic parks and lakes to shopping, dining, and fitness facilities, residents can enjoy a well-rounded living experience.

Restaurants

A diverse selection of dining options is available near Green Community East Dubai, ranging from casual eateries to fine dining and fast-food outlets. Popular restaurants within a 6 to 10-minute drive include Entey Nalukettu Restaurant – DIP, Bedouinn’s Bistro, Sarhad Darbar Restaurant EBC, Nawab Authentic Indian Restaurant, Daily Express Restaurant, Oregano DIP, Zenzi Thai, Emir Turkish Restaurant, and Manaesho. Other favorites such as Hengchen, Subs & Salads Restaurant LLC, Aquamarine, Green Chilly Restaurant, Mamaesh DIP, Arabian Grill Restaurant, and Neha’s Restaurant cater to a variety of tastes and cuisines.

For those looking to unwind over a cup of coffee, several well-known cafés are nearby. Options like Costa Coffee, MOON Walk Café, Meto Coffee, Venecia Coffee Shop, and Starbucks are just 6 to 9 minutes away, making them convenient spots for casual meetups and quick refreshments.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Green Community East DIP Dubai offers a variety of recreational and wellness facilities, ensuring a well-balanced lifestyle for residents. Several community parks, including GC East Park, DIP Park, and Ewan Child Park, provide open green spaces for relaxation and outdoor activities. Families with children can also enjoy nearby playgrounds and dedicated kid’s parks. For swimming enthusiasts, GC East Pool 1, GC East Pool 8, and Pool 7 are conveniently located within a short distance.

Fitness enthusiasts have access to several well-equipped gyms just 7 minutes away from Green Community East Dubai Investments Park. Popular options include Twist Gym, Fitness Founders, Torque Fitness Dubai, Fly High Fitness, and Atlas Power Gym. Additionally, martial arts training is available nearby at Alliance Dubai Jiu-Jitsu Academy and MBA Dynamic Martial Arts Training Club LLC, both within a 6 to 7-minute drive.

For personal care and relaxation, residents can visit salons and spas within the community. Hair Lounge Ladies Salon, NBAR Nail Spa & Salon Green Community, and White Feather Beauty Salon are all accessible within an 8-minute drive, offering a range of beauty and wellness services.

Community Events

Green Community East hosts a variety of community events throughout the year, fostering a strong sense of neighborhood spirit. Residents can enjoy seasonal festivals, family-friendly gatherings, outdoor markets, and fitness activities that bring the community together. These events create opportunities for socializing, entertainment, and engagement, making the neighborhood a lively and welcoming place to live.

Attractions and Landmarks

Residents of Green Community East Dubai have several entertainment and leisure destinations within easy reach. Jumeirah Golf Estates Club House, one of the top golfing venues in Dubai, offers multiple membership options, allowing golf enthusiasts to enjoy world-class courses along with exclusive dining discounts. The clubhouse also features a Sports Bar, providing the perfect setting to unwind and catch up on live sporting events.

For those who appreciate nature, Dubai Miracle Garden is just a 14-minute drive from Green Community East DIP. As the world’s largest flower garden, it showcases breathtaking 2D and 3D floral installations, attracting visitors from around the globe. Nearby, the Dubai Butterfly Garden offers a unique experience, featuring 10 climate-controlled domes that house around 15,000 butterflies from over 50 species.

With these attractions close to Green Community Dubai Investment Park, residents can enjoy a mix of outdoor recreation and entertainment without having to venture far from home. The Green Community East location ensures that leisure activities, from golf to nature-inspired outings, are always within easy reach.

Green Community East offers a peaceful and well-planned residential environment with spacious homes, lush landscapes, and a strong sense of community. With a variety of property options, excellent amenities, and easy access to key areas in Dubai, it provides a balanced lifestyle for families and professionals alike. Its gated setting ensures privacy and security while still offering convenient access to shopping, dining, and recreational facilities nearby.

Where is Green Community East located?

Green Community East is a gated residential sub-community within the larger Green Community in Dubai Investments Park (DIP). 

What types of properties are available in Green Community East?

The area offers a mix of family-oriented villas, townhouses, and apartments, catering to various preferences and family sizes. 

Is Green Community East a freehold area?

Yes, Green Community East is a sought-after freehold area, allowing expatriates to own property.

What amenities and facilities are available in Green Community East?

Residents have access to community parks, swimming pools, fitness centers, and various retail and dining options within the community.

How is the connectivity and transportation in Green Community East?

The community is well-connected, with the Dubai Investment Park Metro Station on the Red Line and several bus stops within the area, facilitating easy commutes.
Explore the well-connected and serene surroundings of Green Community East, perfectly positioned within Dubai Investments Park.

data.content:
Green Community East is a well-established residential area within Dubai Investment Park (DIP), developed by Properties Investment LLC. Spanning 67 hectares, this thoughtfully planned community is known for its lush landscapes, pedestrian-friendly design, and a tranquil living environment. Designed to offer a peaceful retreat from the city's fast pace, it features a mix of townhouses, villas, apartments, and commercial spaces, making it a desirable location for families and professionals alike.

The residential properties in Green Community East (Phase 1) cater to diverse lifestyles. The neighborhood consists of 75 spacious family villas, 10 premium luxury villas, and 310 well-designed townhouses. Additionally, the community provides various apartment options, including terrace, garden, and lake-view residences, all set in a serene and well-maintained setting. The architecture emphasizes open spaces, natural light, and a strong connection to greenery, creating a balanced and relaxing atmosphere.

With a strong focus on convenience, Green Community Dubai Investment Park is situated near The Market, a shopping complex featuring over 110 retail stores. Residents have access to a variety of international fashion brands, supermarkets, banks, restaurants, cafés, and beauty salons, making daily life effortless. The community is also well-served by top-tier schools, nurseries, and healthcare facilities, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle in one of Dubai Investment Park’s most sought-after residential areas.
